controles.affirmation: Marge brute GAAP record de 49,5% et resultat operationnel GAAP en hausse de 60% au T1 FY2027
controles.verbatim_source: GAAP gross margin was 49.5 percent, up 780 basis points ... GAAP operating income was $259 million, up 60 percent (CP T1 FY2027, 28 juillet 2026 ; compte de resultat : Operating income 258,551 vs 162,094)
controles.correction_proposee: Le communique ne qualifie pas la marge brute de 'record' : c'est un ajout de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Ces chiffres integrent 61 M$ de remboursements de droits de douane, soit environ 5% du chiffre d'affaires du trimestre
controles.verbatim_source: These numbers include $61 million in tariff refunds ; Net sales $1,227,234 (milliers) -> 61/1227 = 5,0%

controles.affirmation: Hook et titre de bloc : 'remboursement FISCAL ponctuel de 61 M$'
controles.correction_proposee: Il s'agit de remboursements de DROITS DE DOUANE (tariff refunds), pas d'un remboursement fiscal/d'impot. Le corps de l'ATT le dit correctement, le hook et le titre du bloc quantitatif non : harmoniser.

controles.affirmation: Le directeur financier reconnait que hors remboursement le resultat operationnel non-GAAP n'aurait progresse que de 14% et non de 44%
controles.verbatim_source: While our reported results benefited from tariff refunds, our operational performance was impressive even excluding these refunds, with non-GAAP operating income growing 14 percent year over year (Matteo Anversa) ; Non-GAAP operating income was $290 million, up 44 percent
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la phrase du CFO est presentee comme un point de FORCE ('impressive even excluding these refunds'). L'ATT en fait un aveu ; le sens du verbatim est inverse.

controles.affirmation: La marge operationnelle non-GAAP visee pour l'exercice, en haut de la fourchette 15-18%, est aidee par ce remboursement
controles.verbatim_source: the Company continues to expect full-year non-GAAP operating margin to track near the high end of the 15-18 percent long-term target range, helped by strong operating performance and this quarter's tariff refunds

controles.affirmation: 61 M$ representent environ 10% du profit brut du trimestre (607,9 M$)
Ventes T1 FY2027 +7% en dollars, +5% a change constant ; guidance T2 0% a 3% ; resultat operationnel non-GAAP guide 185-210 M$ contre 290 M$ au T1
controles.verbatim_source: Sales were $1.23 billion, up 7 percent in US dollars and 5 percent in constant currency ; Sales growth 0% - 3% ; Non-GAAP operating income $185 - $210 million ; Non-GAAP operating income was $290 million

controles.affirmation: Dixieme trimestre consecutif de croissance ; tresorerie 1,75 Md $
controles.verbatim_source: Strong First Quarter Marks Tenth Consecutive Quarter of Growth ; The quarter-ending cash balance was $1.75 billion (bilan : 1,749,679)

controles.affirmation: Dividende en hausse continue depuis plus de dix ans
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune source citee ne l'atteste. kpis-haut LOGN.SW ne remonte qu'a FY2021 (0,87 -> 1,36 CHF, six exercices de hausse). L'AR FY2026 dit seulement 'increase the cash dividend per share for fiscal year 2026 by approximately CHF 0.10'.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire 'en hausse chaque annee depuis au moins l'exercice 2021' ou sourcer la serie longue.

controles.affirmation: Fin juin 2026, incident grave chez un fournisseur de semi-conducteurs, fermeture temporaire ; environ 20 M$ d'impact au T2, jusqu'a 200 M$ au T3, resolution largement acquise d'ici le T4
controles.verbatim_source: in late June 2026, a serious incident in the manufacturing facilities of one of Logitech's semiconductor suppliers resulted in its temporary closure ... a Q2 headwind of approximately $20 million in net sales caused by this supplier incident. For Q3, based on limited available information, the negative impact of the supplier incident is estimated to be up to $200 million in net sales. The incident is estimated to be largely resolved by Q4, which would mean little to no impact to Q4 results.

controles.affirmation: Approvisionnement en composants cles aupres de sources limitees ; la demande de puces memoire liee a l'IA et aux data centers a deja fait monter les prix, certains fournisseurs reorientant leurs capacites
controles.verbatim_source: We purchase certain products and key components used in our products from a limited number of sources ... We have been impacted by the increases in demand for memory chips and other components caused by the build out of new AI technologies and data centers, leading to a rise in prices for such components and some suppliers transitioning capacity away from certain components utilized in our products. (10-K FY2026, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: C'est un fait nouveau par rapport a l'exercice precedent
controles.verbatim_source: La phrase 'build out of new AI technologies and data centers' n'apparait pas dans le 10-K FY2025 (LOGN.SW_URD_2025_2025-05-23) : 0 occurrence.

controles.affirmation: Environ 35% des produits fabriques dans des usines detenues en propre en Chine ; le reste chez des sous-traitants en Chine, Vietnam, Thailande, Mexique, Malaisie, Taiwan
controles.verbatim_source: We produce approximately 35% of our products at the facilities we own in China. The majority of our other production is performed by third-party contract manufacturers, including original design manufacturers in China, Vietnam, Thailand, Mexico, Malaysia, and Taiwan.

controles.affirmation: Un risque place EN TETE du chapitre Facteurs de risque du rapport annuel FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: Le Summary of Risk Factors du 10-K FY2026 liste dans l'ordre : (1) 'If we fail to innovate and develop new products...', (2) 'If we do not successfully execute on our growth opportunities...', (3) 'Our principal manufacturing operations and third-party contract manufacturers are located in China and Southeast Asia...'
controles.correction_proposee: Le risque Chine/Asie du Sud-Est est le TROISIEME du sommaire des facteurs de risque, pas le premier. Supprimer 'en tete' ou ecrire 'parmi les premiers risques listes'.

controles.affirmation: Ratio de remuneration de la directrice generale Hanneke Faber a 222 fois la remuneration mediane des employes (FY2026)
controles.verbatim_source: the median of the annual total compensation of all employees of our company (other than our CEO) was $48,110 and the total compensation of Ms. Johanna 'Hanneke' Faber, our CEO, was $10,660,029 ... the ratio ... was 222 to 1 (Compensation Report FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Seules les actions inscrites au registre peuvent voter : 70,6 millions sur 143,6 millions en circulation au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, there were 70,582,377 shares registered and entitled to vote out of a total of 143,566,251 Logitech shares outstanding (issued shares, net of treasury shares).
controles.correction_proposee: Le document ajoute : 'The actual number of registered shares that will be entitled to vote at the meeting will vary depending on how many more shareholders register' — le chiffre est un instantane, pas un plafond.
